Westside Gunn — curator, visionary, ad-lib deity, luxury/street duality

Benny the Butcher — hustler poet, the blade of the group
Art meets drug tales meets wrestling meets couture
Independent empire (WSG’s marketing genius should be TAUGHT in schools)
The new standard for underground rap branding
overview.closing: Griselda teaches taste, discipline, and edge.
